first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person in a red-and-blue skintight suit moving continuously through the air between buildings, appearing mainly as a dark human-shaped silhouette in the later portion.

entities.name: Gray overcast sky
entities.identification: A background of gray clouds visible above and between the buildings.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: A collection of reddish-brown, gray, gray-green, and glass-facade buildings on both sides of the road and in the distance.

entities.name: City street
entities.identification: A gray road and intersections extending into the depth between the central buildings.

entities.name: Neighborhood trees
entities.identification: A collection of green and yellow-green tree canopies on both sides of the road and between the buildings.

entities.name: Street vehicles
entities.identification: A background group of multiple light-colored, yellow, and dark-colored cars on the street surface.

entities.name: Thin line pulled by the person
entities.identification: A thin linear object extending from near Person A's raised hand toward the top of the image.

entities.name: Building facade billboard
entities.identification: A collection of horizontal graphic and text billboards attached to the exterior walls of buildings.

entities.name: Aircraft A
entities.identification: The silhouette of a small gray fixed-wing aircraft continuously visible in the upper part of the sky.
